review_text: i ve been playing warframe since gauss update which is around or so awesome fast paced looter shooter game i don t usually play third person shooter game with photo realistic design like these but this one is an exception the warframe design which are like bio mechas are amazing the gameplay is really fun and it s not just about the gun it also have melee and warframes ability which combine into unique build you can also change your warframes functionality like strength duration and range with mod and such the cinematic story are phenomenal and i still praise them till this day the game also ha a lot of game mode which we will also come to this later the game also ha amazingly friendly comunity a well this game is free to play while having aaa game level of design and you can grind premium currency ingame pretty easily however the game is quite grindy which is the least worst thing on the list you want to play with new stuff now but you have to wait day for it to finish crafting which kill off the hype every content update brings you new game mode which is another content island that ha barely anything to do with the rest of the game with material that once you have everything you can craft with that material will with no doubt never want to have anything to do with that game mode ever again although a lot of content update add a lot of refreshing new game mode and well content they all feel so different that it feel like another game entirely every time the game also lack a form of endgame content by that i don t mean sitting in survival for hour killing level foot soldier by that i mean actual hard boss assassinate mission are a joke the boss are forgettable save for eidolons orb and ropalolyst which are not available for majority of the player unless they grind really hard to unlock them not to mention actually be able to beat them railjacks are fun for the first hour or so but it s also another content island which you don t want to have anything to do with aside from those liches and sister hunt are actually quite fun challenging and memorable a a bos and doe give some nice us or raijacks a their dramatic final confrontation the new orowyrm in duviri paradox is also quite something too but wayy too easy i stopped playing warframe around the new war but it s still fun enough to keep me coming back to the game occasionally because of the fun gameplay the mechanic deep under it keep pushing me away and every update with new game mode keep getting me dumbfounded of what is going on and what to do every time i return tldr very fun game with fun gameplay but once you look deeper you will see a mess behind the mechanic
